title: Enhanced application assignment
resolutionText:
The application assignment mechanism includes updates that offer greater flexibility to institutions and Administrators:

- [Workload and supervisor settings](https://help.dreamapply.com/kb/users/administrator-roles/manage-accounts/#add-administrator-accounts): The Workload % setting and Supervisor/Mentor selection are now located on the Administrator account setup page.
- [New rule actions](https://help.dreamapply.com/kb/enrollment/review/assign-applications/use-rules/): Additional assignment actions are available. You can now configure rules to assign an Administrator from a preconfigured pool or assign an Administrator with a specific role.
- [Bulk Administrator assignment](https://help.dreamapply.com/kb/enrollment/review/assign-applications/manually-assign/#assign-applications-in-bulk): You can now assign or unassign Administrators to or from applications in bulk.

![Bulk application assignment](https://help.dreamapply.com/kb/get-started/images/select-offers.png)
